explanation: The theorem bounds the L² energy of the t-derivative of the library-specific function `affineNoiseRoot f (A s) (a s)`. It uses the library's own `affineNoiseEnergyConstant`, `affineNoiseGenerator` and `integral_matrix_affine_inverse`. All of its content depends on those definitions. I did not search Mathlib's source, because no general Mathlib statement about an affine-noise square-root density's derivative energy is plausible. The proof uses only generic Mathlib lemmas (`integral_div`, `Real.sq_sqrt`, `abs_of_pos`) together with library lemmas. I did not find a Mathlib declaration that states this result.
